changeSet.author: melany
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE cat_status ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(255),
CONSTRAINT uq_cat_status_entity_code UNIQUE (entity_type, code) );
